Let AM be the perpendicular drawn from A to BC.

∴ AM is perpendicular bisector of BD

BM=MD

questions.solution:
$\frac{\cos A}{a}=\frac{\cos B}{b}=\frac{\cos C}{c}\Rightarrow \frac{\cos \mathrm{A}}{2 \mathrm{R} \sin \mathrm{A}}=\frac{\cos \mathrm{B}}{2 \mathrm{R} \sin \mathrm{B}}=\frac{\cos \mathrm{C}}{2 \mathrm{R} \sin \mathrm{C}}\Rightarrow \cot A=\cot B=\cot C\Rightarrow \mathrm{A}=\mathrm{B}=\mathrm{C}=60^{\circ} \Rightarrow \Delta \mathrm{ABC}$ is equilateral
